title: Testing Settlement Flags after Late Evidence and Process Restart
abstract: arXiv:2611.26665v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A settlement flag can survive an application restart while the economic effects remain ambiguous. We define a contract linking the fixed plan, source admission at two cutoffs, identity-keyed ledger effects and post-invocation state. We generated 504 synthetic histories, ran each through a file implementation and a separately coded SQLite implementation, and observed 672 controlled process exits. The file implementation missed 54 same-identity payment-date conflicts, including 27 that credited cash early, and a monitor using run flags, artifact presence and purchase counts accepted all 54. The same contract distinguishes a purchase awaiting closure from a correct quote wait for a single writer on a running kernel and filesystem.

translated_title: 迟到证据与进程重启后的结算标志测试
translated_abstract: 结算标志可能在应用程序重启后仍然存续，而其经济影响却处于不明确状态。我们定义了一个契约，将固定计划、两个截止时点的数据源准入、以身份为键的账本效应以及调用后的状态联系起来。我们生成了504条合成历史记录，将每条记录分别通过一个文件实现和一个独立编码的SQLite实现运行，并观察了672次受控进程退出。文件实现遗漏了54个同身份付款日期冲突，其中包括27个提前入账现金的情况，而一个使用运行标志、产物存在性和购买计数的监视器接受了全部54个。同一契约在运行中的内核和文件系统上针对单一写入者，能够区分等待关闭的购买与正确的报价等待。
tldr: 本文提出一个将固定计划、双截止时点数据源准入、身份键控账本效应与调用后状态绑定的结算标志契约，使其语义在进程重启后仍可验证，并通过504条合成历史、双实现差分测试和672次受控进程退出，发现文件实现遗漏了54个同身份付款日期冲突且常规监视器完全无法察觉。
en_tdlr: This paper defines a settlement-flag contract linking fixed plans, two-cutoff source admission, identity-keyed ledger effects, and post-invocation state whose semantics survive process restarts, and via differential testing of 504 synthetic histories across two implementations with 672 controlled process exits reveals that a file implementation missed 54 same-identity payment-date conflicts that a run-flag-based monitor entirely failed to detect.
